title: Diffraction Grate
pages: Craft the Diffraction Grate from two sealed steel plates, a Ruled Diffraction Grating, a Scored Prism Blank, a Filtered Prism, two glass panes, a hopper and a Spectral Filter. The blank is produced by the Prism Scorer; an ordinary plate does not bypass this t7 gate. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a gallium ingot via forge:ingots/gallium; all existing progression gates remain required.

The Ruled Diffraction Grating is the grate's dispersing element and sits in the bottom-right crafting slot. Craft an aluminium ingot (forge:ingots/aluminum) above a glass pane into an Aluminized Grating Blank: the glass is the flat substrate and the aluminium the reflective film. The Prism Scorer then rules fine parallel grooves into the film (scoring recipe, 240 ticks at 24 FE/t, east amethyst guide required). An unruled blank or a plain plate in that slot does not complete the craft. Automate it by piping blanks into the Scorer's top face and pulling gratings from its bottom face.

Twenty datapack diffraction recipes refine light-adjacent minerals: quartz, amethyst, redstone, lapis and prismarine components convert back and forth, and their blocks break down into the loose form. JEI shows the ingredient, FE per tick, output space and priority. Recipe type: arcana_industry:diffraction; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Eight prismarine shards diffract into one nautilus shell, so routing the shell through filtration, collapse and crushing returns fewer shards than it spent.

The very first recipe diffracts an Attuned Quartz (made by the Resonance Infuser) into a Diffraction Core, a part with no other source. The Lens Collimator now needs one Diffraction Core in place of its second sealed steel plate corner: a bare plate there no longer completes that craft, so the Diffraction Grate must be built before the Lens Collimator.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
